title: My Little Violet
style: pop, jazz, bossa nova, Spanish guitar, female vocals, jazzy, vocal, low, latin, light, bright, beautiful, soft, warm
lyrics:
[Verse]
In the morning sun so warm and true
Jessica beholds her Violet shining through
Directly from the flower
Latin viola so fine
Purple and faithful
This little light of mine
She grows low and humble with her head bowed in grace
But her spirit is bright in this beautiful place
Faithful like the violet that returns every spring
Jessica’s little flower
Hear the guitar sing

[Chorus]
Jess ee ka ka
Jazzy ee e e
Baby b b b
Violet
A light so bright
My heart’s delight
Mum and baby in these violet days
Spanish guitar playing our love always
Jess ee ka ka
Jazzy ee e e
Baby b b b
Violet
A light so bright
Shining in our eyes
Modest and faithful
Humble and true
Jessica beholds her and so does the sky

[Bridge]
[Spanish guitar solo]
[Scat]
Ooooh mi pequeña Violet
Luz brillante
Coo coo coo my flower so true
Doo bee doo
Spanish guitar for you

[Verse 2]
Jessica watches with foresight and love
Her little Violet
Gift from above
Humility and virtue in every tiny smile
Lighting up the garden for a little while
Loyal and devoted
Returns with the light
The sweetest little panther in the daytime bright
[soft laugh]
Jess ee ka ka
Jazzy ee ee

[Chorus]
Jess ee ka ka
Jazzy ee e e
Baby b b b
Violet
A light so bright
My heart’s delight
Mum and baby in these violet days
Spanish guitar playing our love always
Jess ee ka ka
Jazzy ee e e
Baby b b b
Violet
A light so bright
Shining so bright
Jessica beholds you every single day
My little Violet in the most beautiful way

[Outro]
Jess ee ka ka
Jazzy ee ee
Baby b b b
Violet
A light so bright
Good morning
My love
